build_glm_image_processor: build a GLM-Image processor that wraps an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal image generation
call_glm_image_processor: call the GLM-Image processor to encode images and text into model-ready input tensors with pixel values and grid dimensions
build_prompt_with_target_shape: build a prompt string with target image dimensions for text-to-image or image-to-image generation modes
build_target_image_grid_thw: build a target image grid tensor with height, width, and tile dimensions for the model
configure_glm_image_kwargs: configure GLM-Image processor kwargs for target image height, width, and text padding settings
